why: your edgebar dev build (herdr pane w1:p4) runs from this tree and reloads on edits, so it is the real surface to check against

decision: took the custom shell's look from its QML source, not a screenshot
why: brett-desktop has game mode on, which hides the shell; switching it off would disturb a live session
evidence: /run/user/1000/game-mode = on; scratchpad desktop/qs-DP-2-small.png shows no frame

why: TCC rejects nix kitty-bin's signature for the official kitty grant; herdr has no grant
evidence: log show: Failed to match existing code requirement for subject net.kovidgoyal.kitty

decision: assistant tab runs the claude CLI in print mode, no API key
why: it already has your login; a key would be one more thing to set up and pay for separately
evidence: claude -p --output-format stream-json --tools '' --model haiku: ttft 677 ms, 2.27 s total

decision: UI settings go in a new writable settings.json layered over the Nix config.json
why: config.json is a read-only store symlink; the custom shell uses the same defaults-plus-overrides model

decision: calendar is a month viewer first; events only if the macOS probe finds a workable source
why: ambxst's calendar has no events at all, so a month grid matches the reference

decision: settings is a notch view, not a separate window as in ambxst
why: the rail already reserves a Settings tab and Brett asked for a settings view there

decision: AirDrop toggle replaced by Caffeine (keep the Mac awake)
why: setting AirDrop's mode needs com.apple.private.airdrop.settings; the unentitled API returns a wrong value; ambxst's fifth toggle is Caffeine
evidence: macOS probe report Q5; ambxst QuickControls.qml:52-124

decision: Focus toggle runs a user-named Shortcut; state read from ~/Library/DoNotDisturb/DB/Assertions.json
why: donotdisturbd rejects unentitled XPC; Shortcuts has dnd.set; the JSON is readable only through kitty's Full Disk Access
evidence: probe Q3: DNDStateService XPC error Code=3; access.c disclaimed EPERM
result: decided; liveness of the JSON unproven

decision: Bluetooth: state from the com.apple.bluetooth.power notify key, set with IOBluetooth off the main thread with a timeout
why: IOBluetooth raises a Bluetooth TCC prompt for the responsible app (kitty); the notify key needs no permission
evidence: probe Q2: AUTHREQ_PROMPTING kTCCServiceBluetoothAlways for kitty at 00:34:27

decision: notification history reads macOS's usernoted SQLite store read-only; dismiss hides an entry in edgebar only
why: only source; needs Full Disk Access, which edgebar inherits from kitty today; writing Apple's DB is out of bounds
evidence: probe Q6: group.com.apple.usernoted/db2/db, disclaimed open EPERM

decision: calendar ships as a month grid with no events for now
why: EventKit needs NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription on the responsible app; kitty lacks it, and a request may abort edgebar; ambxst has no events either
result: decided; events need a bundled helper app, left open
